digest.component_or_area: LLM runtime authentication and ProviderSession integration
propositions: Auth capabilities must be injected into the existing per-run ProviderSession without forking the RP-01 path or creating second runners/clients
Provider-native auth (boto3 Session, Anthropic access-token provider, OpenAI workload identity) must reach only the official SDK builder and preserve native refresh/expiry/invalidation semantics
Missing or conflicting explicit auth must fail before a provider model request without fallback to anonymous, alternate-principal, or cross-provider candidates
Auth credentials and session capabilities must remain non-serializable and excluded from LLMConfig, RunRequest, snapshots, fingerprints, caches, CLI/MCP schemas, and public output
RP-01's authoritative operation boundary, budget, output repair, cache, tracing, usage, failure behavior, and Agent lifecycle must remain unchanged
